💡 The novelty lies in an asymmetric cooperative solvation structure using DME/DEE to spatially decouple thermodynamic stability from kinetic transport via enthalpy–entropy compensation. Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in designing zwitterionic TPU as an active ion-regulating matrix, not a passive reservoir: phosphate sites coordinate Li⁺ while quaternary ammonium and urethane N-H immobilize TFSI⁻, suppressing swelling via ionic crosslinking. Machine-learning modeling reveals reduced ion-pair separation penalties, enabling uniform Li⁺ flux and stable inorganic-rich SEI. This yields improved cycling, rate capability, and flexible pouch-cell performance, establishing zwitterionic molecular engineering as a promising interface-stabilizing strategy.

💡 The novelty lies in shifting e-waste recycling from metal-centric recovery to valorizing spent graphite from battery black mass as an OER electrocatalyst. Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using TPTC, an N-heterocyclic molecule with four pyridine units, as an electrolyte additive that simultaneously regulates Li+ solvation and interfacial chemistry via ion-dipole interactions and anion enrichment.
